description:
Wethm: Sleep Enhancer is an IoT device for enhancing your sleep. It not only serves as a contactless sleep tracker but also functions as a sleep inducer and a smart vibration alarm.

 

Wethm monitors the user’s heart rate, breathing rate, sleep stages, sleep quality and duration, as well as the temperature, humidity, and noise level in the user’s sleep environment.

 

Our device also aids users in falling asleep faster through gentle vibrations. Have you ever felt drowsy when traveling by train or car? This is the concept behind Wethm’s sleep induction. Gentle vibrations elevate alpha waves and guide you into sleep.

 

Another feature is the smart alarm, which offers several advantages compared to a typical phone alarm. It awakens you through vibrations, ensuring a soundless wake-up that will not disturb the person sleeping next to you. Additionally, it initiates the waking process gently a few minutes prior to your set alarm time, bringing you into a light sleep stage before waking you. This helps prevent sleep inertia, a state where a person feels groggy upon waking. In this way, Wethm helps you feel more energized each day!

 

The final function is called Harmony. Through Harmony, you can access sleep data of your loved ones to check on their sleep and identify any potential health issues they should address. Regardless of the distance, you can monitor the well-being of your grandparents, parents, or children without the need for daily calls.

 

The Wethm app is free to use and will remain so. You can track your sleep, utilize sleep induction, and employ the smart vibration alarm at no cost. Only Harmony is a paid service; accommodating up to four Harmony members costs $3.99 USD per month, while up to ten members costs $7.99 USD per month.
